CONTROLS

WASD
Walk or drive
Shift
Sprint
Space
Jump · handbrake · open parachute while falling
R
Car, helicopter or skyscraper lift · talk to people in Story mode · climb down manholes into the sewer
SpaceShift
Helicopter up and down · mouse steers
ClickRight-click
Helicopter guns and rockets
Click
Punch or use your weapon
1–9
Pick an item (or scroll)
F
Drop item
Right-click
Hold to aim and zoom with a gun or blower · otherwise drops an item
Z
Start or stop a zombie wave
I
Bites turn people into zombies
L
Last stand: survive the waves
Tab
First or third person
/
Map: a bird's-eye photo of the whole world · drag, zoom, click a place to mark it
,
Your phone: camera and selfies, map, places, pets, weather, contracts
;
Flashlight on or off: points where you look. The battery lasts about 2½ minutes and recharges while it's off
.
Throw a bottle to pull zombies away
WW
Double-tap W on a motorbike, dirt bike, scooter or bicycle to pull a wheelie (hold W to keep it up, up to 10 seconds)
R
Also: petrol pumps, vending machines, ATMs, your car's boot (stand behind it), crossing buttons on traffic lights, the pizza shop. Press R again while climbing into a car to skip it
F / Click
Fire your car's roof gun (it can shoot down the police helicopter)
V
Switch between toys and building
R
At the airport (east of the city): fly a bomber jet. W/S throttle, mouse steers (look up to climb), Space or Click drops a bomb, R bails out
R
At a tower crane's base: drive the wrecking ball (AD swing, WS trolley, Space/Shift cable)
X
Crouch down on one knee (Space stands up) · with the build bar open, pick up a block you placed
B
Find places: the Hardware & Arms store, Vehicles R Us, Tumbleton Motors, houses for sale and your garage. An arrow shows the way
`
Clear dropped items and zombies
R
Next to a wheelie bin, dumpster, wall vent, locker or portaloo: hide inside (zombies and the Bull lose you). Hold W to peek, R or Space to get out. If the Bull is within 7 m when you climb in, it pulls you out
Click
With food in your hands (pizza from the pizza shop, drinks and snacks from vending machines): eat it. You walk slower while eating. C switches between your weapons and the food
U
Summon the Bull: the fog rolls in and it hunts you for 90 s (run, hide or stun it). The Expedition Journal is on your phone
C
Switch weapon
Q E
Lean left and right to peek round corners (on foot) · Q is the horn and siren in vehicles
M
Sound on or off
R
Tap to use things, get in and out · hold to reload a gun (hold 1 s with no gun: back to the plaza)
K
High or low graphics
O
Cycle the look: low-poly, classic blocky, then Sam (you play as Survivor Sam). Restarts the town
T
Restart (asks first) · story chapter or whole story
J
Play online (Sandbox): join a public server, join a private one with its code, or make your own · Enter chat
Y
Slow motion
P
Restart from nothing (press twice)
H
Show or hide this panel · the full 📖 How to play guide is in the B menu and on the start screen
